cells.gaps: No source found says online business registration is in service; the Ministry of Commerce says full electronic filing will follow the county pilot.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: the Ministry of Commerce launched a business registration digitalisation and decentralisation project in August 2026, piloted in seven counties (LBR-002), which answers question 1 as a launched project. Electronic filing is still to come, so not stage 3.
